meta.name: add-vercel
meta.description: Add Vercel deployment capability to NanoClaw agents. Installs the Vercel CLI in agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com. Use when the user wants agents to deploy web applications to Vercel.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让智能体把网站部署到 Vercel
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你想用智能体自动部署网站到 Vercel
copy.tagline_en: Let your agent deploy websites to Vercel
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want your agent to automatically deploy websites to Vercel

howto.what: 给 NanoClaw 的 agent 容器装上 Vercel CLI,并在 OneCLI 里配好 api.vercel.com 的凭证注入。之后 agent 就能把网页应用部署到 Vercel,并执行部署、查看部署列表、检查登录身份等操作。
howto.when: 当你想让 agent 把网页应用部署到 Vercel 时触发。前提是 OneCLI 可用,若不可用需先运行 /init-onecli 再重试。

say.text: 帮我把这个网页应用部署到 Vercel
say.note: 走部署流程,产出生产环境部署

say.text: 列一下我账号下的 Vercel 部署记录
say.note: 用 vercel ls 查部署列表

say.text: 检查一下当前 Vercel 的登录身份
say.note: 用 vercel whoami 验证凭证

howto.what_en: Installs the Vercel CLI into NanoClaw agent containers and sets up OneCLI credential injection for api.vercel.com, so agents can deploy web applications to Vercel and run deploy, list, and auth checks.
howto.when_en: Use when you want an agent to deploy a web application to Vercel. OneCLI must already be working; if not, run /init-onecli first, then retry /add-vercel.

say_en.text: Deploy this web app to Vercel for me
say_en.note: Runs the deploy flow and produces a production deployment

say_en.text: List the Vercel deployments on my account
say_en.note: Uses vercel ls to show deployments

say_en.text: Check which Vercel identity is logged in
say_en.note: Uses vercel whoami to verify credentials
